title: Create Aeronautics Basics
description: With A Booming Use of Physics This Modpack Is Just The Basics For Your Next Adventure...
body:
# Welcome to the Home of Create Aeronautics

Create Aeronautics Basics is designed to be the ultimate, lightweight stepping stone for your next great Minecraft adventure. Instead of overwhelming you with hundreds of conflicting mods, this pack cuts straight to the chase—delivering a finely tuned, vanilla-plus environment built entirely around physics, engineering, and exploration.

## 🔧 The Ultimate Stepping Stone for Create

If you’ve ever wanted to master the Create Mod without the clutter, this is your starting line. The pack focuses heavily on mechanical innovation, allowing you to learn the ropes of kinetic energy, automation, and rotational power. With the addition of Create Aeronautics, your builds are no longer anchored to the ground. Design fully functional, physics-driven airships and moving machinery that seamlessly interact with the world around you.

## 🌍 Built for Adventure & Multiplayer

Take to the skies and explore. Whether you are charting out new territories with integrated real-time maps or coordinating a multi-crew airship build with friends using proximity voice chat, this pack is optimized from the ground up for a seamless multiplayer experience. Every feature is chosen to enhance how you interact with the environment and your fellow engineers.

## ⚡ Clean, Lightweight, and High Performance

No stuttering, no massive RAM drains. A dedicated optimization suite works silently under the hood to ensure your framerates stay high, even when massive mechanical airships are flying through the sky. Combined with clean user-interface overlays that display recipes, item details, and survival stats at a glance, you get a polished, high-performance sandbox designed for pure innovation.

### Build it, fly it, and conquer the skies. Your next engineering adventure starts here.
